title: HPCC: high precision congestion control
authors: Yuliang Li; Rui Miao; Hongqiang Harry Liu; Yan Zhuang; Fei Feng; Lingbo Tang; Zheng Cao; Ming Zhang; Frank Kelly; Mohammad Alizadeh; Minlan Yu
venue_full: Conference on Applications, Technologies, Architectures, and Protocols for Computer Communication
affiliations: Harvard University, Alibaba Group Holding Limited, University of Cambridge, Massachusetts Institute of Technology

problem_statement.en: Existing high-speed congestion control schemes for RDMA networks struggle to simultaneously achieve ultra-low latency, high bandwidth utilization, and network stability, often leading to PFC storms or deep packet queues.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 RDMA 網路的高速壅塞控制方案難以同時實現超低延遲、高頻寬利用率與網路穩定性，往往引發 PFC storm 或深度封包佇列。

key_innovation.en: HPCC (High Precision Congestion Control) leverages In-network Telemetry (INT) to obtain precise link load information, allowing senders to compute accurate flow rate updates and control inflight bytes to maintain near-zero queues.
key_innovation.zh: HPCC（High Precision Congestion Control）利用網路內遙測（INT）獲取精確的鏈路負載資訊，使發送端得以計算準確的流量速率更新並控制在途位元組數，從而維持近零佇列。

key_improvements.en: 95% reduction in 99th-percentile flow completion time (FCT) compared to DCQCN, near-zero in-network queues, and elimination of PFC pauses under incast events.
key_improvements.zh: 相較於 DCQCN，p99 流完成時間（FCT）降低 95%；網路內佇列接近零；incast 事件下的 PFC 暫停現象得以消除。

ai_task: Distributed Deep Learning, Cloud Storage, Database, HPC
network_hw: Barefoot Tofino, Broadcom Tomahawk3, Broadcom Trident3
